Validation data

The validation leaves come from ashiklom/spectra_db. LOPEX and ANGERS are the only projects there with reflectance and transmittance plus measured chlorophyll, carotenoids, water (EWT) and dry matter (LMA). The ten leaves below span the trait ranges of those two libraries and include senescent, white/variegated, sclerophyllous and very thin leaves. A synthetic PROSPECT-D spectrum with known parameters and N(0, 0.005) noise is included as a parameter-recovery check.

  • LOPEX: Perkin-Elmer Lambda 19 with an integrating sphere, 400–2500 nm, 5 replicate R/T measurements per leaf (replicate 1 is fitted; all 5 are used on Error models).
  • ANGERS: ASD FieldSpec with a leaf clip, 400–2450 nm, one R/T pair per leaf.
  • EWT and LMA are already in g cm⁻², the units of PROSPECT’s \(C_w\) and \(C_m\). Neither library measured anthocyanins.

Spectra

NoteLeaves considered and excluded
  • yang_pheno (Harvard Forest seasonal series) has many young, anthocyanin-rich leaves, but its R/T files for the candidate red-oak leaf look scrambled: R jumps 0.02 → 0.10 → 0.03 → 0.34 across 550–800 nm, and the wavelength rows are out of order. It also has no EWT. an03r0128 (highest anthocyanin reflectance index among the ANGERS leaves) is used instead.
  • lopex_11 and lopex_66 look like dried leaves without pigment measurements.
  • processed-spec-data/*.rds holds the same LOPEX/ANGERS data in an older R format; the spectra_db CSVY files were used instead.
